name: active_documents_by_sequence
note: ProductTemplate._compute_product_document_count / action_open_documents (addons/product/models/product_template.py:278,1008): active documents in _order 'sequence, name'; name is inherited from ir.attachment (PostgreSQL), so the replay orders by sequence then id over the document columns only
source_sql: SELECT id, ir_attachment_id, sequence, active, attached_on_sale FROM product_document WHERE active = true ORDER BY sequence, id

name: documents_per_attachment
note: product_document__ir_attachment_id_index / ProductDocument._inherits delegation (addons/product/models/product_document.py:11-20): one document per attachment, counted per ir_attachment_id
source_sql: SELECT ir_attachment_id, count(*) AS documents FROM product_document GROUP BY ir_attachment_id ORDER BY ir_attachment_id
